payload.text: NEXT (P0, hv decisions 39 to 46), in order. (1) devbin's last proof run, k342, of its two units still banked: 0342-1, the fix for the wait-on-a-process-substitution race, and 0344-1, which runs a cut's remote legs after its local gates (k340 put 0334-2, 0341-1, 0340-1 and 0340-2 on devbin's main at 8f35cb72). Then devbin-vc's landing, hv's history rewrite and hv's cut of devbin 0.1.23, hv's brew steps, and devbin-vc's sweep into Intent's tree; cc gives the sweep a diff check for a packaging/homebrew change (hold 36). (2) dc's one Desk slot on rhadamanth, booked from devbin-vc's Desk after the sweep, every step one after the other and none beside a kovacs run (hv decision 45): (a) the WP-06 (c) to (e) proof on refs/bank/dc/0093-06/cde-draft-unproved-v3-on-fdd9fa2df rebased onto the sweep, its arms red then green and the bats suite at 24 jobs; (b) 0682's by-hand bin/devbin gate rust with TMPDIR on a 1.7G disk image, run on gyges beside (a) in a clone carried by git bundle, since gyges is not bound by hv decision 45 and gate rust needs no GNU parallel (vc, 2026-11-12; it stays on rhadamanth after (a) if gyges lacks anything it needs); (c) dc banks, and vc lands WP-06 with 0682's Resolution and close; (d) bin/devbin release gates --leg kovacs; (e) the dry run, whose pre-flight runs no gate. intentd stays up through the slot and no seat stops it (hv decision 46), so (e) stops at the pre-flight step, which still runs every check and names every refusal: it passes when the live daemon is the only refusal, and any other is a finding. Before (e), vc calls a freeze: every seat commits its board, then nothing writes to Intent's tree until hv's cut has finished, not even a pickup, and vc confirms git status is empty. (3) At that HEAD, which vc sends to ic, ic reads that reference_current_check.sh exits 0 and that DIRT_SCOPE has not moved since 9500cb77a, the pair docs/known-defects.md was driven on at 52c251f0a; ic regenerates docs/reference only if a landing moved the register or ALL_VARIANTS. The rest of releasing.md step 2 needs no more work (vc's read, by 13:09Z on vc's date -u): every user-facing issue closed since v3.3.0 has its CHANGELOG entry, while 0687 changes Debug builds alone, 0688 a parity tool, and WP-06 and 0682 the development tooling, so none needs one, and only the sweep could add one, by cc's hold 36 read; and the explorer screenshots need no run, since nothing the explorer draws has changed since v3.3.0. (4) hv's cut of v3.3.1 (hv decision 44) by intent/docs/releasing.md: hv stops intentd at step 0, then runs the dry run, whose rows after the pre-flight print for the first time there, then the cut; the macOS stage first runs in the cut, before the tag; hv starts intentd again at the end of step 4; then releasing.md step 5, the public site's db/release.json, which still names 3.2.7 because the 3.2.8 and 3.3.0 cuts skipped it, and whose push is outward, so who runs it is put to hv; then vc tells agentic-engineering-vc it is installable. (5) Other projects' memory folders get ST0093 WP-01's prune when the plan rolls out to the estate.
